name: Sigil
author: pellinore377
description: Sigil — a cross-platform native Matrix client: rooms, DMs, spaces, media and native voice/video calls, backed by sigil-engine. This plugin is its Omarchy bar widget and panel. Toggle with: omarchy-shell shell toggle pellinore.sigil

barWidget.description: Bar icon that toggles the Sigil (Matrix) window; badges unread messages, mentions and an active call
